title: Pedro L Father NDE 3232
content: Well, I'm not the one who had the NDE, it was my father, but since he doesn't have a computer and he has told me the story many times, I'll tell it to you the best I can. Everything happened when he was more or less twenty-three or twenty-four years old. (He was born in 1954.) He had an infected molar so he went to the registered nurse/medical assistant so they would give him an injection of penicillin. He didn't know he was allergic! When the assistant gave him the injection, he got up and took a few steps towards his car to leave when, all of a sudden, he vomited. He noticed that his body seemed to swell up. The doctor - who was still very near - placed him on a stretcher and quickly realized, 'He's allergic!' But as he searched for the antidote or remedy my father felt as if 'something' left his body (his soul, an energy); something which weighed nothing, and he started upwards rapidly, very, very high up - higher, he says, than the clouds. He didn't see the doctor nor did he see anyone down below. He also didn't even think of those below. It was as if he didn't remember them. He doesn't remember a light - or something defined as such - just that everything was very light and that he could move from one side to the other very quickly without tiring and without being thirsty. What he does remember is that he was looking for someone or something, but there was hardly any time, as the doctor injected the antidote and he returned to his body. That's the part he remembers least: how he returned to his body.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Allergic reaction Life threatening event, but not clinical death . I had an allergic reaction to the penicillin that almost cost me my life.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness I was conscious the whole time.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was conscious the whole time.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I believe that time doesn't exist there/up there. It's like a huge infinite space.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain It was not a light at the end of the tunnel as such, or anything like that. Everything was light.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm si, era como ir corriendo por encima de las nubes incluso
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt well, without thirst, without feeling tired. I searched for someone or something but there was no time to find it.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I believe that God has much to do with what exists after death.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I believe that God has much to do with what exists after death.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The part about returning to the body.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Yes, the sensation of being able to 'run' freely, without being tired, without thirst, without pain.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I told my girlfriend as soon as it happened, and my daughter, when she was older. (I didn't have my daughter when it happened.) Yes, they remain very positively affected, I believe. They have lost their fear of death, etc.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. It was a real as this now is real. On top of that, it happened twenty-five years ago and I remember it as if only five minutes had passed.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: No. It's fine the way it is.
